events.title: Jacques Cartier Reaches Prince Edward Island
events.description: During his first voyage of exploration for France, the navigator Jacques Cartier sighted and landed on the island now known as Prince Edward Island. He is the first documented European to reach it.
events.significance: Cartier's voyages underpinned France's claim to large parts of northeastern North America and opened the way to the colonization of Canada.

events.title: The Globe Theatre Burns Down
events.description: During a performance of Henry VIII, a stage cannon fired to herald the king's entrance ignited the thatched roof of London's Globe Theatre. The playhouse, home to Shakespeare's company, burned to the ground.
events.significance: The fire destroyed the most famous stage of the Elizabethan and Jacobean era. The theatre was rebuilt the following year, and its story still shapes how we picture Shakespeare's world.

events.title: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry Is Born
events.description: The future aviator and writer was born in Lyon, France. He drew on his experiences as a pioneering airmail pilot to write works such as Night Flight and Wind, Sand and Stars.
events.significance: He wrote The Little Prince, one of the best-selling and most translated books in history, which remains a classic of world literature.

events.title: Sampoong Department Store Collapses in Seoul
events.description: The five-story Sampoong Department Store in Seoul, South Korea, collapsed completely. It remains one of the deadliest non-deliberate building collapses in modern history.
events.significance: The tragedy exposed serious construction and safety failures, and it prompted South Korea to tighten its building regulations and enforcement.

events.title: The First iPhone Goes on Sale
events.description: Apple's first iPhone went on sale in the United States at 6 p.m. local time, with customers lining up outside stores. It launched at $499 for the 4GB model and $599 for the 8GB model.
events.significance: The iPhone's touchscreen design helped define the modern smartphone and transformed how people communicate, work and use the internet.
